statement.zh: 被围住为变化定下界：从被围住的那一步起，活跃者连同有变化的步不多于那时所立者的总水平。有限世界与被围住的世界在一个选择之下计数规律相同，恰当这个选择约束变化且约束计数；起约束至多再加三条。
statement.en: Enclosure bounds change: from the step it holds, the relata active together with the steps of change stay within the total standing then. Finite and enclosed worlds have the same laws of counting under a selection exactly when it bounds change and binds counting; binding adds at most three more.

laws.zh: 称计数从第 T 步起在变化界 B 之内，若对 T 之后的每一步 t，n t 连同自 T 至 t 之前 c 或 a 为正的步数（occurrences）不多于 B。
laws.en: Say that B bounds change from step T when at every step t from T on, n t together with the number of steps from T before t at which c or a is positive (occurrences) is at most B.

laws.zh: 变化界之内变化不复现；从第 T 步起的变化界是从第 0 步起的变化界，大出 T 与 T 之前的计数。
laws.en: Within a change bound change does not recur; a change bound from step T is one from the first step, larger by T and the counts before T.

laws.zh: 被围住为变化定下界：在有活动的普查、关系项都体现、流平衡且耗散的世界中，从第 T 步起每步被围住时，普查的计数从 T 起在第 T 步所立者的总水平之内：被围住的步上所立者的总水平不升，有生起或止息的步上至少降一，活跃的体现关系项都立着。
laws.en: Enclosure bounds change: in a world with a census of activity whose relata are all embodied, with a balanced, dissipative flow and every step from T on enclosed, the total standing at T bounds the change of the census from T: across an enclosed step the total standing never rises, and it falls by at least one at every step at which something arises or ceases, while the embodied relata active all stand.

laws.zh: 反过来，被围住的队列以自然数为成员，成员恰在队中时活跃并立着一，队首另立着变化界余下的超出成员数的部分；队首参与每一步，从每个成员取用其水平所降的，给予其水平所升的。
laws.en: Conversely an enclosed queue has natural numbers as members, active and standing at one exactly while in the queue, its front also standing at what the bound leaves beyond one for each member; the front takes part at every step, taking from each member what its standing loses and giving each what it gains.

laws.zh: 它的每一步都被其跨度围住，在从第 0 步起在变化界之内、没有成员加入空队的每个计数表之下满足全部八个前提：平衡由构造，每个有变化的步上所立者降一，所以耗散成立。
laws.en: Every step is enclosed by its span, and the queue meets all eight premises under every tally with a change bound from the first step in which nothing joins an empty queue: balance holds by construction, and what stands falls by one at every step of change, so dissipation holds.

laws.zh: 所以对计数的一个逐点的性质，在满足全部八个前提、从某步起每步被围住的每个世界的普查中成立，恰当它对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起、从第 0 步起在某个变化界之内的计数表成立。
laws.en: So a pointwise property of the counts holds of the census of every world meeting all eight premises with every step from some step on enclosed exactly when it holds of every tally with a change bound from the first step in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active.

laws.zh: 这样的队列从不超过第 B + B·B 个成员，放在这些位置上是满足全部八个前提的有限世界，所以有限世界中计数的规律相同，从某步起被围住的世界与有限世界有相同的计数规律。
laws.en: Such a queue never reaches past its B + B * B-th member, and on those places it is a finite world meeting all eight premises, so finite worlds have the same laws of counting, and worlds enclosed from some step on and finite worlds have the same laws of counting.

laws.zh: 在有限的队列中耗散起约束，这个界可以达到：第 0 步替换一个成员时，队首从全部位置的封闭家族取用两个单位，第 0 步所立者总共为二，此后一个成员连同一步变化恰为二。
laws.en: In the finite queue dissipation binds and the bound is attained: with one member replaced across the first step the front takes two units from the closed family of all places, and what stands at the first step totals two, one member with one step of change behind it making two at every later step.

laws.zh: 变化不复现不能加强为终结之步：若每个从第 0 步起在变化界之内、没有成员加入空队的计数表都有一步之后不再变化，或每个满足八个前提、活动可判定的有限世界都有一步之后不再生起，有限全知原则 LPO 成立，见证（Swap）在布尔序列的第一个真处替换一个成员。
laws.en: That change does not recur cannot be strengthened to an end step: if every tally with a change bound from the first step in which nothing joins an empty queue had a step after which nothing changes, or every finite world meeting the eight premises with decided activity a step after which nothing arises, the limited principle of omniscience LPO would hold, the witness (Swap) replacing one member at the first true of a Boolean sequence.

laws.zh: 在每个前提选择之下：被围住的一步上只需平衡、耗散与体现，没有关系项活跃时那里所立者的总水平为零，任何成员开始立着都会使它下降，所以没有生起，不论谁给予、谁取用。
laws.en: Under each selection of the premises: at an enclosed step balance, dissipation and embodiment suffice, for with nothing active the total standing there is nothing and any member coming to stand would lower it, so nothing arises, whoever gives and whoever takes.

laws.zh: 被围住的队列不论计数都只在活跃时取用，它的耗散逐步成立，只要求该步没有成员加入空队、前后两步都在所立者之内。
laws.en: Whatever its counts, the enclosed queue takes only while active, and it dissipates step by step, asking only that nothing join an empty queue at the step and that both steps stay within what stands.

laws.zh: 在第 T 步闭合的队列在 T 之前让每个关系项与队首各交换一个单位，所以 T 之前没有家族封闭；它平衡，从 T 起它的流就是被围住的队列的流，每步被围住，从 T 起有变化界、此后没有成员加入空队时它耗散。
laws.en: A queue closing at step T has every relatum exchange a unit each way with the front before T, so no family is closed before T; it balances, from T on its flow is the enclosed queue's and every step is enclosed, and with a change bound from T and nothing joining an empty queue from then on it dissipates.

laws.zh: 称一个选择约束变化，若它选中平衡、体现与耗散。
laws.en: Say a selection bounds change when it selects balance, embodiment and dissipation.

laws.zh: 所以在从某步起每步被围住的世界中，在八个前提的每个选择之下，对计数的一个逐点的性质在满足这个选择的每个世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个满足两个条件的计数表成立：选择约束计数时，没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起；选择约束变化时，从某步 T 起变化在一个界之内，且从 T 起没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起。
laws.en: So in worlds with every step from some step on enclosed, under each selection of the eight premises a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every world meeting the selection exactly when it holds of every tally meeting two conditions: where the selection binds counting, nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active; where it bounds change, from some step T on change stays within a bound and nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active.

laws.zh: 后一个条件须带着它的步：变化界之内变化不复现，这本身不给出这样的一步。
laws.en: The second condition carries its step: that change does not recur within the bound gives no such step by itself.

laws.zh: 不选耗散时，被围住不约束计数：变化界为零的被围住的队列实现其余条件下的每个计数表；缺平衡或缺体现时，不流动的队列每步都被围住。
laws.en: Without dissipation enclosure leaves counting free: the enclosed queue with bound zero counts every tally meeting the other conditions; without balance or embodiment the still queues are enclosed at every step.

laws.zh: 所以被围住时，从某步起的变化界（连同此后没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起）是一个选择之下的计数规律，恰当这个选择约束变化：不约束变化时，每步多一个的计数由满足这个选择、从某步起被围住的世界实现。
laws.en: So under enclosure a change bound from some step, with nothing arising from then on across a step at which nothing is active, is a law of counting under a selection exactly when it bounds change: where it does not, a count growing by one at every step is counted by a world meeting the selection and enclosed from some step on.

laws.zh: 有限世界中每步被围住，所以在那里平衡、体现与耗散本身就约束计数，并给出从第 0 步起的变化界，每个普查至多计到关系项那么多。
laws.en: Every step of a finite world is enclosed, so there balance, embodiment and dissipation by themselves bind counting and bound change from the first step, and every census counts at most as many as there are relata.

laws.zh: 反过来，把队列的成员依次排在一圈 N 个位置上（第 k+1 个成员坐在第 k 个的下一个位置，满一圈回到第一个位置），相距不到一圈的成员位置不同。
laws.en: Conversely, seat the members of a queue in turn round a ring of N places (member k + 1 sits at the place after member k's, back at the first place once the ring is full); members less than a full turn apart sit at different places.

laws.zh: 每步至多有 M 个在队中时，一圈 2M+1 个位置容得下任一步前后在队中的成员，所以环列出每步被占的位置，各一次，计到队列所计的。
laws.en: Where at most M are in the queue at each step, a ring of 2M + 1 places holds those in it before or after any step, so the ring lists the places held at each step, each once, and counts what the queue counts.

laws.zh: 不立任何东西的环满足除体现外的全部前提，每个位置被占时立着一的环满足除平衡外的全部前提，其队首的位置再从每个位置取用其水平所降的、给予其所升的，满足除耗散外的全部前提，没有成员加入空队时也满足只有活跃者给予。
laws.en: A ring with nothing standing meets every premise but embodiment; a ring each of whose places stands at one while held, every premise but balance; and with its front's place also taking from each place what that place's standing loses and giving what it gains, every premise but dissipation, only active relata giving where nothing joins an empty queue.

laws.zh: 所以在有限世界中，在八个前提的每个选择之下，对计数的一个逐点的性质在满足这个选择的每个有限世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个满足三个条件的计数表成立：每步至多有某数个活跃；选择约束计数或约束变化时，没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起；选择约束变化时，从第 0 步起变化在一个界之内。
laws.en: So in finite worlds, under each selection of the eight premises, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every finite world meeting the selection exactly when it holds of every tally meeting three conditions: at most some number active at each step; where the selection binds counting or bounds change, nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active; where it bounds change, change within a bound from the first step.

laws.zh: “没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起”在有限世界中是一个选择之下的规律，恰当这个选择选中平衡与体现，并选中只有活跃者给予或耗散；从第 0 步起的变化界是规律，恰当这个选择约束变化：每步替换一个成员的计数由满足其余任一选择的有限的环实现；所以 256 个选择在有限世界中给出三种规律。
laws.en: That nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active is a law in finite worlds under a selection exactly when it selects balance and embodiment, and only active relata giving or dissipation; a change bound from the first step is a law exactly where the selection bounds change, one member replaced at every step being counted by a finite ring meeting any other selection; so in finite worlds the 256 selections give three kinds of law.

laws.zh: 有限世界与从某步起被围住的世界在一个选择之下有相同的计数规律，恰当这个选择约束变化且约束计数：不约束变化时，每步多一个的计数由每步被围住的世界实现，不由任何有限世界实现；约束变化而不约束计数时，一个关系项在被围住之前从无到有地生起由被围住的世界实现，不由任何有限世界实现。
laws.en: Finite worlds and worlds enclosed from some step on have the same laws of counting under a selection exactly when it bounds change and binds counting: where it does not bound change, a count growing by one at every step is counted by a world enclosed at every step and by no finite world; where it bounds change without binding counting, one relatum arising from none before enclosure is counted by an enclosed world and by no finite world.

laws.zh: 从某步起被围住时，在满足八个前提且每个前提都起约束的世界中，对计数的一个逐点的性质在每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起、从第 0 步起有变化界且有某个生起的计数表成立；见证是被围住的队列把依存网饱和，其中每个前提都起约束，普查也是，因为关系项是自然数。
laws.en: With enclosure from some step on, in worlds meeting the eight in which every premise binds, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census exactly when it holds of every tally with nothing arising across a step at which nothing is active, a change bound from the first step and something arising, the enclosed queue with its web saturated binding every premise, the census included since its relata are the natural numbers.

laws.zh: 更一般地，从某步起被围住时，在每个选择 S 之下，对计数的一个逐点的性质在满足 S、从某步起被围住且 S 所选的每个前提都起约束的每个世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个满足 World.enclosed_counting_under 的两个条件与 World.binding_counting_under 的三条的计数表成立。
laws.en: More generally, with enclosure from some step on, under each selection S, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every world meeting S, enclosed from some step on, in which each premise S selects binds exactly when it holds of every tally meeting the two conditions of World.enclosed_counting_under and the three of World.binding_counting_under.

laws.zh: 被围住与起约束各自加上自己的规律，三条各自恰在与不被围住时相同的选择之下多出，因为生起可以在被围住之前。
laws.en: Enclosure and binding add their laws each on its own, each of the three under exactly the same selections as where nothing is enclosed, since what arises may arise before enclosure.

laws.zh: 被围住时的见证：传递在每一步被围住，有损的队列从其给予之后一步起被围住；不选耗散时，队首在生起之后一步与自身再交换一个单位的队列在每一步被围住。
laws.en: Witnesses under enclosure: the relay is enclosed at every step and the lossy queue from the step after its gift; without dissipation, a queue whose front exchanges one unit more each way with itself across the step after something joins is enclosed at every step.

laws.zh: 选中平衡、体现与耗散而不选只有活跃者给予与只有活跃者取用时，耗散只能在有所可失的封闭之步上起约束，于是队列在一个有关系项活跃、此后没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起的步闭合，其队首在那一步多立一个单位并在跨这一步时失去它；其余情形用饱和的被围住的队列。
laws.en: With balance, embodiment and dissipation but neither only active relata giving nor only active relata taking, dissipation binds at a closed step only where something stands to be lost, so the queue closes at a step at which something is active, from which on nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active, its front standing one unit more there and shedding it across the step; otherwise the enclosed queue saturated.

laws.zh: 没有有限世界使普查起约束，所以在选中普查的选择之下，有限世界中每个性质都是规律。
laws.en: No finite world binds the census, so under a selection with the census every property is a law in finite worlds.

laws.zh: 在不选普查的每个选择 S 之下，对计数的一个逐点的性质在满足 S 且 S 所选的每个前提都起约束的每个有限世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个满足 World.finite_counting_under 的三个条件、并满足以下三条的计数表成立：S 选中活动需要支持、只有活跃者给予或只有活跃者取用时有关系项活跃；S 选中体现时有某个生起；S 选中体现与有界传递，并选中只有活跃者给予、或同时选中只有活跃者取用与耗散时，在有关系项活跃的一步上有生起。
laws.en: Under each selection S without it, a pointwise property of the counts holds of every census of every finite world meeting S in which each premise S selects binds exactly when it holds of every tally meeting the three conditions of World.finite_counting_under and three more: something is active where S selects activity needing support, only active relata giving or only active relata taking; something arises where S selects embodiment; and something arises across a step at which something is active where S selects embodiment and bounded transmission with only active relata giving or with both only active relata taking and dissipation.

laws.zh: 所以有限世界中起约束所加的，恰是有关系项活跃（选中活动需要支持、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用或体现时）、有某个生起（选中体现时）与在有关系项活跃的一步上有生起；后者恰在选中体现，且选择约束计数或约束变化，或选中有界传递并选中只有活跃者给予、或同时选中只有活跃者取用与耗散时成立。
laws.en: So in finite worlds binding adds exactly that something is active (where activity needing support, only active relata giving, only active relata taking or embodiment is selected), that something arises (where embodiment is), and that something arises across a step at which something is active, exactly where embodiment is selected and the selection binds counting or bounds change, or selects bounded transmission with only active relata giving or with both only active relata taking and dissipation.

laws.zh: 这是因为有限世界的每一步都被围住：平衡、体现与耗散本身就约束计数，取用与耗散推出只有活跃者给予。
laws.en: This is because every step of a finite world is enclosed: balance, embodiment and dissipation bind counting by themselves, and taking with dissipation gives only active relata giving.

laws.zh: 见证是有限的环，依存网饱和：不选体现时，环旁的传递把位置 1 所立的两个单位之一交给位置 0，失去另一个，不论位置是否被占。
laws.en: The finite witnesses are rings with saturated webs: without embodiment, a relay beside a ring handing one of the two units place 1 stands at on to place 0 and losing the other, whatever holds the places.

laws.zh: 选中体现、不选平衡，并选中耗散或只有活跃者给予时，有损的环的队首位置跨一步与自身及每个开始被占的位置各交换一个单位，再失去一个单位。
laws.en: With embodiment, without balance and with dissipation or only active relata giving, a lossy ring whose front's place, across one step, exchanges a unit each way with itself and each place coming to be held and loses one unit more.

laws.zh: 选中体现、不选耗散，且不选平衡时也不选只有活跃者给予时，平衡的环在生起之后一步让队首的位置与自身再交换一个单位；选中平衡、体现与耗散时，饱和的有限队列（World.finiteQueue_saturated_binds）。
laws.en: With embodiment, without dissipation, and without only active relata giving where balance is not selected, a balanced ring whose front's place exchanges one unit more each way with itself across the step after something arises; with balance, embodiment and dissipation, the finite queue with its web saturated (World.finiteQueue_saturated_binds).

laws.zh: 被围住之界与被围住对计数的约束对每个世界的确切形式见 laws-of-one-step，World.enclosure_bounds_change 与 World.enclosed_binds_counting 是它的推论。
laws.en: The exact form for every world of the enclosure bound and of enclosure binding counting is in laws-of-one-step, of which World.enclosure_bounds_change and World.enclosed_binds_counting are corollaries.

hypotheses.zh: 列出与可判定：同 whole-law-of-counting；读于世界时是活动可判定。这是表示的逻辑承诺。
hypotheses.en: Listing and decidability: as in whole-law-of-counting; read of worlds, decided activity. It is a logical commitment of the representation.

hypotheses.zh: 逐点（Pointwise）：同 whole-law-of-counting，代替函数外延性，是定理的假设。
hypotheses.en: Pointwise: as in whole-law-of-counting, in place of function extensionality, a hypothesis of the theorems.

hypotheses.zh: 被围住与有限：从某步起每步被围住、世界有限，是世界的条件，作为定理的假设陈述，不是公理。
hypotheses.en: Enclosure and finiteness: every step from some step on enclosed, or the world finite, are conditions on worlds, stated as hypotheses of the theorems, not axioms.

does_not_show.zh: 只对每步有限的活动陈述。
does_not_show.en: Stated for activity finite at each step.

does_not_show.zh: 只说活动的计数，前提之下所立者与依存的计数见 counting-standing-and-dependence。
does_not_show.en: It speaks only of the counting of activity; the counts of standing and dependence under the premises are in counting-standing-and-dependence.

does_not_show.zh: 变化界以被围住时所立者的总水平为界，可以用尽，但不是每个世界的值。
does_not_show.en: The change bound is the total standing at enclosure, which can be attained but is not the value in every world.

does_not_show.zh: 界数的是有变化的步，不是事件。
does_not_show.en: The bound counts steps of change, not events.

does_not_show.zh: 被围住的队列中活动需要支持与有界传递空成立（没有什么依存于什么）；每个前提都起约束时计数的全部规律见 whole-law-of-counting，只多出有某个生起。
does_not_show.en: In the enclosed queue activity needing support and bounded transmission hold vacuously (nothing depends on anything); the whole law of counting where every premise binds, adding only that something arises, is in whole-law-of-counting.

does_not_show.zh: 没有有限世界使每个前提都起约束；有限世界中除普查外每个前提都起约束时的规律见 whole-law-of-counting。
does_not_show.en: No finite world binds every premise; the laws in finite worlds where every premise but the census binds are in whole-law-of-counting.

does_not_show.zh: 变化不复现，终结之步一般地需要全知。
does_not_show.en: Change does not recur, and an end step needs omniscience in general.

detail.zh: Swap 与 ChangeBound.lpo_of_ends：在布尔序列的第一个真处替换一个成员的计数在变化界二之内，变化不复现，而对每个这样的计数构造性地给出终结之步就是 LPO。
detail.en: Swap with ChangeBound.lpo_of_ends: replacing one member at the first true of a Boolean sequence has its change bounded by two and change does not recur there, while an end step constructed for every such count is LPO.

detail.zh: World.replaced_attains：变化界的界可以用尽，enclosure_bounds_change 不能加强；World.lpo_of_finite_ends：满足八个前提的有限世界中，此后不再生起之步一般地需要全知。
detail.en: World.replaced_attains: the bound is attained, so enclosure_bounds_change cannot be strengthened; World.lpo_of_finite_ends: in finite worlds meeting the eight premises a step after which nothing arises needs omniscience in general.

detail.zh: World.finite_change_bound_iff 与 World.enclosed_iff_finite_counting_under：每步替换一个成员的计数由满足除体现、除平衡或除耗散外全部前提的有限的环实现，所以变化界只在选择约束变化时是有限世界的规律；每步多一个的计数由每步被围住的队列实现，Queue.lone_settles 的一个关系项在被围住之前从无到有地生起，所以在其余的选择之下有限世界与被围住的世界的计数规律不同。
detail.en: World.finite_change_bound_iff and World.enclosed_iff_finite_counting_under: one member replaced at every step is counted by finite rings meeting every premise but embodiment, balance or dissipation, so a change bound is a law of finite worlds only where the selection bounds change; a count growing by one at every step is counted by queues enclosed at every step, and in Queue.lone_settles one relatum arises from none before enclosure, so under the other selections finite and enclosed worlds have different laws of counting.

detail.zh: World.finite_binding_joint_iff 与 World.finite_binding_census：选中体现，而选择既不约束计数与变化、也不选中有界传递连同只有活跃者给予或只有活跃者取用与耗散时，一个关系项在第一步从无到有地生起并留下（Queue.lone），由一个满足选择且所选前提都起约束的有限世界实现，生起之步上没有关系项活跃；所以第 3 条只在所说的选择之下是规律。在有限世界中它在比不被围住时（whole-law-of-counting）更多的选择之下成立：选中体现、平衡与耗散而不选只有活跃者给予与取用时，或选中体现、只有活跃者取用、耗散与有界传递而不选平衡与只有活跃者给予时。选中普查时没有有限世界使所选前提都起约束，规律空洞地是一切性质。
detail.en: World.finite_binding_joint_iff and World.finite_binding_census: with embodiment selected but a selection neither binding counting nor bounding change, nor selecting bounded transmission with only active relata giving or with only active relata taking and dissipation, one relatum arising from none across the first step and staying (Queue.lone) is counted by a finite world meeting the selection in which each selected premise binds, nothing being active at the step it arises; so the third law is a law only under the selections named. In finite worlds it holds under more selections than where nothing is enclosed (whole-law-of-counting): with embodiment, balance and dissipation but neither only active relata giving nor taking, and with embodiment, only active relata taking, dissipation and bounded transmission but neither balance nor only active relata giving. With the census selected no finite world binds the selected premises, and every property is vacuously a law.

detail.en: World.enclosed_binding_joint_iff: with embodiment, balance and dissipation selected but a selection neither binding counting nor selecting only active relata giving and bounded transmission, the same relatum arising from none and staying (Queue.lone) is counted by a world enclosed from the first step on, meeting the selection, in which each selected premise binds (a shedding queue, whose front sheds its spare unit across the first step), nothing being active at the step it arises: in finite worlds the third law holds here, under enclosure from some step on it does not, since what arises may arise before enclosure.

correspondence.zh: 停息定理（ceasing-needs-arising、continued-change-needs-openness）说被围住时变化不再复现；本结果给出它的定量形式，以及它在计数上的全部内容：被围住的展开中，计数只多受一个变化界约束，其余由计数表与八个前提给出（whole-law-of-counting）；在全部八个前提之下，在计数上有限世界与从某步起被围住的世界无法区分，在一个前提选择之下恰在它约束变化且约束计数时无法区分；被围住所加的恰在选中平衡、体现与耗散时出现，有限所加的还有计数的界，以及耗散从第一步起对生起的约束。作者的读法（AI 论证）：变化界就是被围住时所立者总水平的逐步耗散在计数上的样子；在被围住的展开中，每一次形成或消解都耗去关系中立着的一些东西，能不息地变化的是开放的展开（continued-change-needs-openness）；没有耗散，封闭的家族可以不取用而给予，被围住就不再约束计数；有限的世界从第一步起就被围住，所以在那里不需要只有活跃者取用，耗散连同平衡与体现就使生起需要在场者。这是活动的计数，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；它不是 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠，所以这一读法不是其所指；二者读作对能形成者的扩大与缩小，DELEGATED-CHOICES D2）；它也不评价生起、止息或停息。
correspondence.en: The rest theorem (ceasing-needs-arising, continued-change-needs-openness) says change does not recur under enclosure; this result gives its quantitative form and all it says of counting: in an enclosed unfolding the counts are constrained by a change bound and by nothing more than the tally and the eight premises (whole-law-of-counting); under all eight premises, in counting, finite worlds cannot be told from worlds enclosed from some step on, and under a selection of the premises they cannot be told apart exactly where it bounds change and binds counting; what enclosure adds appears exactly where balance, embodiment and dissipation are selected, and finiteness adds a bound on the count and the constraint of dissipation on arising from the first step. The author's reading (an AI argument): the change bound is what the stepwise dissipation of the total standing under enclosure looks like in the counts; in an enclosed unfolding every forming or dissolving spends something standing in the relations, and what can change without end is the open unfolding (continued-change-needs-openness); without dissipation a closed family can be given to without taking, and enclosure no longer constrains counting; a finite world is enclosed from the first step, so there only active relata taking is not needed: dissipation with balance and embodiment already makes arising need what is present. This is the counting of activity, whose English names arising and ceasing Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names; the Chinese 生起／止息 being the AI's rendering); it is not the proposal's generative and degenerative (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap, so this reading is not what is meant; they read as widening and narrowing what can form, DELEGATED-CHOICES D2); it evaluates neither arising, ceasing nor rest.
